name: Turtwig
description: This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Leafage
moves.description: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: The user bites the target with viciously sharp fangs to inflict damage.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user tramples its target into the ground, dealing damage. This also lowers the target’s action speed.

moves.name: Sleep Powder
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of sleep-inducing powder that makes the target drowsy.

moves.name: Leaf Blade
moves.description: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and attacks by cutting its target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user.
